GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1100m commenced to over race when the pace steadied. Bumped near the 500m. Was bumped near the 300m. When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding rider explained that her mount had not appreciated the quick back up after racing at Scone on Tuesday 2 September 2025 and after over-racing in the early and middle stages had failed to respond when placed under pressure. A post-race veterinary examination found the gelding to be slow to recover.
